newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu to travel out of Zaire Wednesday - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to travel out of Zaire Wednesday - spokesman.

text.p: Embattled Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko will travel to Gabon on Wednesday and return to the capital Kinshasa on Friday, his spokesman Kabuya Lumuna said on Tuesday.
The announcement came as Laurent Kabila's rebels were pressing towards the city of five million people, principally from the east.
"It is confirmed that the president will go to Libreville on Wednesday and will return on Friday. He is attending a meeting of heads of state," Kabuya told Reuters.
